# Contributing

## AI-Assisted Contributions

We welcome contributions that use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.). If you used AI to help write a PR, there is no need to disclose it, we review all code on its merits.

Do not submit AI-generated code you don't understand, and always test your changes before opening a pull request. Low-effort drive-by PRs will be closed.
